title: Detailed cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='potGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8823c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b5501f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cactusGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2f9e44'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#51cf66'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2b8a3e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='armGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2f9e44'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#4fc463'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2b8a3e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#6b4226'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='21' ry='4.5' fill='#8a5a33'/>

  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='52' height='9' rx='4' fill='#e8823c'/>
  <rect x='24' y='64' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f5a05f'/>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M27 73 L73 73 L68 94 Q67 97 64 97 L36 97 Q33 97 32 94 Z' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <path d='M30 76 L36 94 Q36.5 95.5 38 95.5 L40 95.5 L35 76 Z' fill='#f5a05f' opacity='0.75'/>
  <path d='M62 76 L68 76 L64 94 Q63.5 95.5 62 95.5 Z' fill='#8f3c14' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- main cactus body -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q42 62 41 52 L41 26 Q41 14 50 14 Q59 14 59 26 L59 52 Q58 62 50 62 Z' fill='url(#cactusGrad)'/>
  <!-- body ridges -->
  <line x1='46' y1='18' x2='46' y2='60' stroke='#2b8a3e' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='18' x2='54' y2='60' stroke='#2b8a3e' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='61' stroke='#74d68a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>

  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d='M41 40 L30 40 Q25 40 25 45 L25 50 Q25 54 29 54 L34 54 Q37 54 37 51 L37 47 Q37 46 38 46 L41 46 Z' fill='url(#armGrad)'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='42' x2='30' y2='52' stroke='#2b8a3e' stroke-width='1.4'/>

  <!-- right arm (higher) -->
  <path d='M59 30 L70 30 Q75 30 75 35 L75 40 Q75 44 71 44 L66 44 Q63 44 63 41 L63 37 Q63 36 62 36 L59 36 Z' fill='url(#armGrad)'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='32' x2='70' y2='42' stroke='#2b8a3e' stroke-width='1.4'/>

  <!-- spines -->
  <g stroke='#f8f4d8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='43' y1='24' x2='39' y2='22'/>
    <line x1='43' y1='34' x2='39' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='43' y1='44' x2='39' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='43' y1='54' x2='39' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='24' x2='61' y2='22'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='34' x2='61' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='44' x2='61' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='54' x2='61' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='44' x2='23' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='50' x2='23' y2='49'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='34' x2='77' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='40' x2='77' y2='39'/>
  </g>

  <!-- flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='4.5' fill='#ff8ec7'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='10' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='10' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='16' r='3.2' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='16' r='3.2' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='2.6' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
